calls.statement:
SELECT fiscal_period, fiscal_year, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
ORDER BY fiscal_period;

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  AND p.category = 'Garden'
  AND s.store_id <> 999
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;
